checks.name: annotation and predecessor bindings
checks.evidence: audit --review review/annotation_review_v2.json: 40 packets, 81 claims, 24/12/4 gold, 271 predecessor files, zero exact duplicate text; predictions_executed=false.

checks.name: one measured start
checks.evidence: run writes START.json with exclusive creation before worker subprocess; existing marker prevents another worker start even with another output path.

checks.name: gold and review metadata exclusion
checks.evidence: project_family accepts raw and normalized rows plus coverage; packet keys omit case ID, title, gold, tags, reasons and reviewer judgments. Gold is joined after saved predictions for measurement.

checks.name: metric buckets
checks.evidence: metric_group separately computes pass-to-fail, fail-to-pass, review by gold class, ambiguous forced decisions, invalid and execution errors, and intended-error localization; REPORT.md currently omits execution-error and localization summaries.

checks.name: prediction envelope
checks.evidence: measure checks ordered packet identities, claim IDs and anchors, but does not validate per-claim verdict vocabulary or consistency of execution_error with overall invalid.

risks.detail: Contract requires separate invalid/execution-error reporting and claim-level localization, while the Markdown report exposes only invalid IDs and a row table. Add explicit execution-error and localization summaries before freeze.

Malformed per-claim verdicts or an execution_error paired with an overall pass/fail could distort localization without being rejected. Validate these fields before measurement and add synthetic negative fixtures.
Agent author/reviewer separation is procedural in a shared filesystem; no human approval or externally held-out benchmark is claimed.

authority: Preflight only; no prediction execution or external authority granted.
